result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on closing SV-04-001. I re-read the Story 4 AC-4.2 requirement and the server design note for package-context ownership, inspected the touched Convex package-context files plus their PlatformStore caller, and reran verification sequentially to confirm the access-control fix landed without introducing touched-surface regressions.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by code change: `convex/processPackageContexts.ts` now exposes `getCurrentProcessPackageContext` via `internalQuery` and `clearCurrentProcessPackageContext` / `upsertCurrentProcessPackageContext` via `internalMutation`, and `convex/processPackageContextMembers.ts` now exposes member reads via `internalQuery`. That closes the public unauthenticated Convex surface that previously bypassed the Fastify control-plane boundary for AC-4.2. Sequential reruns of `green-verify` and `verify-all` passed after the fix.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/server/process-live-updates.test.ts --environment node

mockOrShimAuditFindings: No production-path mocks, shims, or fake adapters were introduced in the package-context access-control fix; the touched change stayed within real Convex/Fastify paths.
additionalObservations: `verify-all` still ends with the repo's scaffold-only `test:e2e` step, so executable end-to-end evidence for this story remains service, client, and integration coverage rather than a live browser suite.
